newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent very quiet with few quotes and no talk.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent very quiet with few quotes and no talk.

text.p: SIMEX Brent futures were very quiet on Monday with no orders seen as most players were away at an industry conference, brokers said.
Only one local was seen making an offer at a high level of $23.00 per barrel for the October contract, brokers said. The November contract was unquoted.
They said they expected the October contract to consolidate as players rolled-over positions into November, ahead of the contract expiry on Thursday.
On Monday, the October contract on London's IPE closed at $22.61 per barrel, for gain of seven cents.

The latest development in Iraq was largely ignored. A Kurdish militia allied to Baghdad said on Monday it had gained control of the whole of northern Iraq after several weeks of fighting with a rival Kurdish group.
The response from the United States has been limited so far to a warning directed at Bahgdad and Tehran to stop fuelling the inter-Kurdish violence.
The NYMEX October contract on the after-hours ACCESS system last traded higher at $23.79, up six cent from its New York close.
